title: I've had sleep paralysis since 2020, so I made a game where the demon is cute and wants to play
author: Rizabekus
selftext:
My first released game. Godot 4, solo. Took me 1.5 month.

Story: you wake up unable to move, a girl is sitting at the foot of your bed, and every game you play with her is a wager - rock paper scissors for your arms, a card game for your breath. 8 endings.

AI:Opus+Sol for coding. Art from Google flow and Chatgpt. The writing and game design are mine. Music and sfx are from Pixabay.

Free in browser: [https://rizzottto.itch.io/dont-sleep-with-her](https://rizzottto.itch.io/dont-sleep-with-her)

Happy to answer how I kept her consistent across poses.
